findings.reason: the write paths must add `reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py`, or the worker is forced to either bypass the single prompt composer (duplicating its worktree/landing-fragment resolution) or request a scope change, which the section's own measure then cannot show.
findings.text: §26's write paths are `reckon/crew/dispatch.py`, `reckon/crew/prompts.py` and the new test, but dispatch never calls `compose_prompt` directly: `reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2333` calls `_compose_dispatch_prompt`, defined at `reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py:1080`, and that function is the one that threads every argument through to `prompts.compose_prompt`; a resolved suite command cannot reach the prompt without a new parameter on it, so "the worker prompt names the resolved command" cannot be implemented inside the declared paths

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2275` reads `gates.suite_command` and `:2505` stores it verbatim, `reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:370` carries `_scoped_suite_command`, `reckon/crew/prompts.py:556` defines `compose_prompt` with no suite-command slot (grep finds no `suite_command` there), and `#s13` resolves and is landed.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — two cases are measurable, and the declared negative control ("storing the template verbatim turns the first case red") is exactly today's dispatch behaviour, so the first case fails on the unfixed code; both cases are exercisable through the existing temp-config dispatch harness (`tests/test_crew_dispatch_arming.py:_dispatch`), and the scoped resolution helpers are already directly tested.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the only path the done-when names is the node-local disk holding the `git archive` measurement arms, which are scratch trees rather than evidence; no session scratchpad or transient evidence path is declared.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new test file `test_a_run_record_carries_its_suite_command.py` and the section prose are behavioural; no plan labels, ticket numbers or version tags.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the section names `compose_prompt` as the prompt's composer, but the production caller that must carry the resolved command into it is `_compose_dispatch_prompt` in `reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py`, which the declared write paths omit.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — one deliverable: the resolved suite command on the run record beside its template, and named in the worker prompt.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §26 declares no depends-on edge and needs none: its premise (§13's landed scoped `{node_test_files}` template) is `s13: done`, and no section consumes §26's output.
